name: Error handler — mail on workflow failure

nodes.name: On workflow error
nodes.notes: Fires when a workflow fails that has this one set under Settings → Error Workflow. It does NOT fire for every workflow automatically.

parameters.subject: =n8n failure: {{ $json.workflow.name }}

nodes.name: Email failure alert to admin
nodes.notes: Sends workflow name, last node, error message and a link to the execution. Recipient is ALERT_MAIL_TO, the admin address of this n8n instance; sender is JOIN_MAIL_USER. Both are environment variables of the n8n container, set in the .env next to its docker-compose.yml and passed through in that compose file, so no address is stored in the workflow. Covers the checklist item 'error handling and logging: email notification on errors'.

parameters.content:
## Error handler
Set as **Settings → Error Workflow** in: Recipe generation, Quota lookup, Quota cleanup.

When one of them fails, the email to ALERT_MAIL_TO contains the workflow name and id, the time (Europe/Berlin), the last executed node, the error message and a link to the failed execution.
